description: He wears an opaque navy wool coat with long sleeves and an open front, reaching below the knees. Tan-gold geometric borders run along the edges; brown fur trims the collar and cuffs. A cream long undertunic has blue geometric bands at the neck, chest and hem. Round bronze-toned chest clasps are joined by a short chain. A brown belt holds a blue-and-gold patterned sash with long tasseled ends. Dark brown trousers tuck into dark brown calf-high boots secured by crossed leather straps. No headgear or weapon is visible.
